decision.reason: [ev-82be76c03b0e] says the v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs were removed from the CRDs, and that `flux migrate` must be run unless Flux Operator deploys the controllers. The proposed exposure can't be accepted as written. Its undecidable leaves use reasons outside the allowed set ("release-knowledge-gap", "environment-visibility-gap"). Whether Flux Operator is used is a configuration fact, not runtime behaviour, so it should be a predicate, not an undecidable leaf. I can't write a correct condition either: neither the evidence nor the section context names the affected CRDs (plural.group) or the old versions to check in status.storedVersions, and nothing says how to detect a Flux Operator deployment (for example an image or kind). The linked Flux v2.7 upgrade guide section would be needed to fill those gaps.
